messages:
claire: Quick sync — proposal: 'Playground Refapp' launch: two hands-on tutorials, an OSS refapp repo, and a 30m 'bench & demo' webinar. Metrics: repo stars, signups, and trial conversions.

josh: I'll own the launch post + paid social slice. Want one hero stat from the bench to use in creative.

mei: DevRel builds the repo. Plan: single tiny app with two routes (chat + embeddings), Docker, and a benchmark script that outputs p50/p95 and cost-per-1k-tokens. Will include GitHub Actions for smoke tests.

ana: I'll handle webinar ops and landing page. Suggest we gate webinar with 2 quick fields: company size + primary use case. Routing rules: enterprise -> SDR; otherwise -> nurture + trial invite + 1-week premium credit.

devops-bot: Reminder: internal webinar template -> https://docs.internal/redwood/webinars/mini-checklist

josh: UTM pattern idea: utm_source=playground_refapp&utm_medium={channel}&utm_campaign=playground_launch&utm_content={variant}

mei: README run example for README:
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood/playground-refapp.git
cd playground-refapp
docker build -t playground .
docker run --rm -e MODEL=gpt-lite playground ./bench.sh --iters 60 --seq 512
```
I'll also add a reproducible notebook for the benchmark.

claire: Benchmark narrative: focus on 'real dev' workload — mixed chat+embeddings latency and cost. Show tradeoffs between small quantized vs full fp16. Josh pick one hero stat (e.g., cost/1000 tokens) for social.

josh: Will draft blog headline options: "Playground Refapp: run a complete inference flow in under 10 minutes" or "Measure inference economics with a 1-file refapp". Leaning to the first.

ana: For inbound routing, add a hidden field capturing utm_content; also enrich leads via Clearbit to avoid manual qualification. We'll push enterprise leads to HubSpot list 'Playground - Enterprise' and kick off SDR sequence.

mei: I'll include test data and expected outputs so CI can validate bench results are within sane bounds before merging.

claire: Timeline: week 0 announce + save-the-date; week 1 tutorial A + repo; week 2 tutorial B + bench teaser; week 3 webinar + full benchmark + blog. Aim to launch four weeks from now.

josh: I'll post first drafts in #marketing-drafts by EOD tomorrow. Need hero stat from Mei within 48h.

mei: :white_check_mark: starting repo skeleton now. Expect bench draft in 36h.

ana: :white_check_mark: landing mock and form fields by Tue. I'll map routing rules to HubSpot.

claire: Great. I'll create the Asana epic and include tags for paid support and PR amplification. React with :white_check_mark: when you accept.

josh: :white_check_mark:

mei: :white_check_mark:

ana: :white_check_mark:

growth-bot: Tip: add a short post-webinar survey with a checkbox "Interested in Dedicated" to capture higher intent leads.

claire: Good call — will add survey and a CTA for the repo + 30-day trial credit. Thanks team :rocket:
